threads.body: `reactionGroups.users(first: 20)` can truncate the list of reactors, which can cause the dashboard to miss an acknowledgement when there are >20 positive reactions on the comment. Since GitHub GraphQL supports up to 100 per page, increasing this to 100 reduces false negatives without requiring extra pagination logic.

Same truncation issue here: limiting `reactionGroups.users` to 20 can drop the specific reviewer whose reaction should count as an acknowledgement. Bump to 100 (GitHub GraphQL max page size) to make acknowledgements more reliable.
